stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Please do not worry about me.”?
options: People still need to ask why it keeps becoming full and what should change.
Responsibility can grow when people understand that their action affects someone they may never meet.
I still miss home, but I am beginning to understand why people like camp.
Things often feel more valuable when people understand what it costs to fix them.
